description: This file defines a 'Loader' component using the Lightning.js framework. It creates an animated loading indicator with three circles that fade in and out in a loop.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A Lightning.js component that displays an animated loading indicator with three flashing circles.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the interval to animate the opacity of the circles, causing them to fade in and out repeatedly.
